description: This file defines an Android activity named Grid1 that displays a grid of app icons retrieved via package manager query, allowing users to see installed launchable apps.

classes.name: Grid1
classes.description: An Activity displaying a grid of app icons, loading the list of launchable applications using PackageManager.

classes.name: AppsAdapter
classes.description: A custom adapter extending BaseAdapter to provide views for each app icon in the grid.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, loads apps, sets content view, and binds the grid with the adapter.

methods.name: loadApps
methods.description: Queries the PackageManager for launchable activities and stores them in mApps.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or recycles ImageView for each app, sets the app icon drawable.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns total number of apps in the list.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the ResolveInfo object for a given position.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the position as item ID.
